ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub EDRKillShifter — BYOVD driver drop chained to EDR/AV process termination
ucs.description: Hunts the RansomHub-signature 'EDRKillShifter' loader pattern: a non-system process drops a kernel driver (.sys) into a writable user/temp path, the driver is loaded, and the actor terminates Microsoft Defender / SentinelOne / CrowdStrike / Sophos / ESET agent processes shortly afterward. RansomHub affiliates have leaned on EDRKillShifter (Sophos X-Ops 'Project AukwarmtH' / Sophos-tracked, also tied to Notchy and the Change Healthcare intrusion) as their pre-encryption defense-evasion step.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstDrop max(_time) as lastDrop from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Downloads\\*") NOT (Filesystem.process_path="*\\Windows\\System32\\*" OR Filesystem.process_path="*\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename dest as host file_path as driver_path | join type=inner host [ | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count values(Processes.process) as kill_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="taskkill.exe" OR Processes.process_name="sc.exe" OR Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" OR Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe") (Processes.process="*MsMpEng*" OR Processes.process="*MsSense*" OR Processes.process="*SenseIR*" OR Processes.process="*SentinelAgent*" OR Processes.process="*SentinelServiceHost*" OR Processes.process="*CSFalconService*" OR Processes.process="*CSAgent*" OR Processes.process="*xagt*" OR Processes.process="*ekrn*" OR Processes.process="*elastic-agent*" OR Processes.process="*Sophos*" OR Processes.process="*Cybereason*" OR Processes.process="*HitmanPro*" OR Processes.process="*WRSA*") (Processes.process="*Stop-Service*" OR Processes.process="*Stop-Process*" OR Processes.process="*taskkill*" OR Processes.process="*sc*stop*" OR Processes.process="*sc*delete*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | eval kill_time=_time ] | where kill_time>=firstDrop AND kill_time<=firstDrop+1800 | table firstDrop kill_time host user process_name process_path driver_path file_hash kill_cmd parent_process_name | sort 0 -firstDrop
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let EdrTokens = dynamic(["MsMpEng","mssense","MsSense","SenseIR","SenseCncProxy","SentinelAgent","SentinelServiceHost","SentinelHelperService","CSFalconService","CSFalconContainer","CSAgent","CrowdStrike","xagt","ekrn","egui","elastic-agent","ElasticEndpoint","SophosAV","HitmanPro","avastsvc","avp.exe","TmListen","Cybereason","cyserver","WRSA"]);
let KillVerbs = dynamic(["Stop-Service","Stop-Process","taskkill","sc stop","sc delete","net stop"]);
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Downloads\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !has @"\Windows\System32\" and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !has @"\Windows\SysWOW64\"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DriverTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverPath = strcat(FolderPath, FileName),
              DriverSha256 = SHA256,
              DropperImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              DropperCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropperUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              DropperSha256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
let EdrKills = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe","sc.exe","wmic.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (KillVerbs)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (EdrTokens)
    | project KillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              KillImage = FileName,
              KillUser = AccountName;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner EdrKills on DeviceId
| where KillTime between (DriverTime .. DriverTime + 30m)
| summarize KillCount = count(),
            FirstKill = min(KillTime),
            LastKill = max(KillTime),
            SampleKill = any(KillCmd),
            EdrTargets = make_set(KillImage, 10)
            by DriverTime, DeviceName, DropperUser, DropperImage, DropperCmd, DropperSha256, DriverPath, DriverSha256
| order by DriverTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let EdrTokens = dynamic(["MsMpEng","mssense","MsSense","SenseIR","SentinelAgent","SentinelServiceHost","CSFalconService","CSAgent","xagt","ekrn","elastic-agent","Sophos","HitmanPro","Cybereason","WRSA"]);
let KillVerbs = dynamic(["Stop-Service","Stop-Process","taskkill","sc stop","sc delete","net stop"]);
let DriverDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".sys"
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Downloads\")
    | where ActingProcessName !has @"\Windows\System32\" and ActingProcessName !has @"\Windows\SysWOW64\"
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project DriverTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256,
              ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername;
let EdrKills = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("taskkill.exe","sc.exe","wmic.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any (KillVerbs)
    | where CommandLine has_any (EdrTokens)
    | project KillTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname = Computer,
              KillCmd = CommandLine, KillImage = NewProcessName, KillUser = SubjectUserName;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner EdrKills on DvcHostname
| where KillTime between (DriverTime .. DriverTime + 30m)
| summarize KillCount = count(),
            FirstKill = min(KillTime),
            LastKill = max(KillTime),
            SampleKill = any(KillCmd)
            by DriverTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256
| order by DriverTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\Temp\*.sys OR *\TEMP\*.sys OR *\AppData\Local\*.sys OR *\appdata\local\*.sys OR *\ProgramData\*.sys OR *\programdata\*.sys OR *\Users\Public\*.sys OR *\Downloads\*.sys) -@Image:(*\Windows\System32\* OR *\Windows\SysWOW64\* OR *\windows\system32\* OR *\windows\syswow64\*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\.sys$/i
| regex("\\\\(Temp|AppData\\\\Local|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|Downloads)\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\Windows\\(System32|SysWOW64)\\/i)
| join(query={#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(taskkill|sc|wmic|powershell|pwsh|net)\.exe$/i | regex("(Stop-Service|Stop-Process|taskkill|sc\\s+stop|sc\\s+delete|net\\s+stop)", field=CommandLine) | regex("(MsMpEng|MsSense|SenseIR|SentinelAgent|SentinelServiceHost|CSFalconService|CSAgent|xagt|ekrn|elastic-agent|Sophos|HitmanPro|Cybereason|WRSA)", field=CommandLine)}, field=[aid], include=[CommandLine, ImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
ucs.rationale: EDRKillShifter is the most distinctive RansomHub-affiliate artefact and combines T1068 (vulnerable driver / BYOVD) with T1562.001 (kill EDR). The chain — non-system process drops a .sys into a user-writable path, then kills a known EDR/AV agent within minutes — is operationally unique to ransomware pre-encryption tradecraft and is documented in CISA AA24-242A and Sophos X-Ops reporting on RansomHu

ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub Rclone-to-MEGA/Backblaze double-extortion exfil pre-encryption
ucs.description: Detects RansomHub affiliates' canonical exfiltration step: rclone.exe (often renamed but with original-filename metadata intact) invoked with copy/sync verbs against MEGA, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, or Storj remotes shortly before encryption. CISA AA24-242A and Mandiant/Halcyon reporting consistently flag this rclone-to-MEGA pattern as the RansomHub data-theft tradecraft preceding the .ransomhub leak-site publication.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process="*rclone*") (Processes.process="*copy *" OR Processes.process="*copyto *" OR Processes.process="*sync *") (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*b2:*" OR Processes.process="*backblaze*" OR Processes.process="*storj*" OR Processes.process="*wasabi*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*" OR Processes.process="*--config*") NOT (Processes.user="*$" OR Processes.user="SYSTEM" OR Processes.user="LOCAL SERVICE" OR Processes.user="NETWORK SERVICE") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | join type=inner host [ | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` sum(All_Traffic.bytes_out) as bytes_out values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ip values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest_host from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest="*mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*backblazeb2.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*wasabisys.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*storjshare.io" OR All_Traffic.dest="*filemail.com") All_Traffic.dest_port=443 by All_Traffic.src | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename src as host ] | where bytes_out > 50000000 | table firstTime lastTime host user process_name process_path cmdline hash bytes_out dest_host dest_ip parent | sort 0 -firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let CloudHosts = dynamic(["mega.co.nz","mega.nz","backblazeb2.com","wasabisys.com","storjshare.io","filemail.com","sync.com"]);
let RcloneTokens = dynamic(["mega:","b2:","backblaze","storj","wasabi","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers","--config"]);
let RcloneVerbs = dynamic(["copy ","copyto ","sync ","move "]);
let Procs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "rclone.exe"
        or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
        or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has "rclone"
        or ProcessCommandLine has "rclone")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneVerbs)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneTokens)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, ProcessId,
              OrigName = ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName, SHA256;
Procs
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudHosts)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              NetProcId = InitiatingProcessId,
              NetProcImage = InitiatingProcessFileName
  ) on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 15m)
| where NetProcId == ProcessId or NetProcImage =~ FileName
| summarize NetConnections = count(),
            DistinctDests = dcount(RemoteUrl),
            DistinctIPs = dcount(RemoteIP),
            SampleDests = make_set(RemoteUrl, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(NetTime), LastSeen = max(NetTime)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, OrigName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| where DistinctIPs >= 2 or NetConnections >= 20
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let CloudHosts = dynamic(["mega.co.nz","mega.nz","backblazeb2.com","wasabisys.com","storjshare.io","filemail.com"]);
let RcloneTokens = dynamic(["mega:","b2:","backblaze","storj","wasabi","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers","--config"]);
let RcloneVerbs = dynamic(["copy ","copyto ","sync ","move "]);
let Procs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (ActingProcessName endswith @"\rclone.exe"
        or ActingProcessFileOriginalName =~ "rclone.exe"
        or ActingProcessFileProduct has "rclone"
        or ActingProcessCommandLine has "rclone")
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneVerbs)
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneTokens)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActingProcessId;
Procs
| join kind=inner (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DstHostname has_any (CloudHosts) or Url has_any (CloudHosts)
    | where DstPortNumber == 443
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DstHostname, DstIpAddr, NetworkBytes
  ) on DvcHostname
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 15m)
| summarize NetConnections = count(),
            TotalBytesOut = sum(NetworkBytes),
            DistinctDests = dcount(DstHostname),
            SampleDests = make_set(DstHostname, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(NetTime), LastSeen = max(NetTime)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| where TotalBytesOut > 50000000 or NetConnections >= 20
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: RansomHub Affiliate Rclone Exfiltration to MEGA/Backblaze/Storj
id: a4f9b2d3-c5e6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects rclone command-line invocations consistent with RansomHub affiliate exfiltration tradecraft documented in CISA AA24-242A - copy/sync to MEGA, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, or Storj remotes.
references:
    - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-242a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
    - attack.exfiltration
    - attack.t1567.002
    - attack.t1048.003
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_image:
        - Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
        - OriginalFileName: 'rclone.exe'
        - Product|contains: 'rclone'
    selection_verb:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - ' copy '
            - ' copyto '
            - ' sync '
            - ' move '
    selection_cloud:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'mega:'
            - 'b2:'
            - 'backblaze'
            - 'storj'
            - 'wasabi'
            - '--multi-thread-streams'
            - '--transfers'
    filter_sysuser:
        User|endswith: '$'
    condition: (1 of selection_image) and selection_verb and selection_cloud and not filter_sysuser
falsepositives:
    - Sanctioned cloud backup operations using rclone (allowlist by service-account UPN)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\RClone.exe OR *\RCLONE.EXE) OR @OriginalFileName:rclone.exe OR @CommandLine:(*rclone*)) AND @CommandLine:(*" copy "* OR *" copyto "* OR *" sync "* OR *" move "*) AND @CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *b2\:* OR *backblaze* OR *storj* OR *wasabi* OR *"multi-thread-streams"* OR *"--transfers"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR regex("rclone", field=CommandLine))
| regex("\\s(copy|copyto|sync|move)\\s", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(mega:|b2:|backblaze|storj|wasabi|multi-thread-streams|--transfers)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| join(query={#event_simpleName=DnsRequest | regex("(mega\\.co\\.nz|mega\\.nz|backblazeb2\\.com|wasabisys\\.com|storjshare\\.io|filemail\\.com)", field=DomainName)}, field=[aid], include=[DomainName])
